notes: Moved Br from meta to para on anilino ring to probe steric/electronic tolerance of EGFR hydrophobic pocket.
Bromine to chlorine bioisosteric halogen swap, reducing molecular weight/lipophilicity while retaining halogen bonding.
Replaced Br with nitrile to maintain similar electronic character while adding H-bond acceptor capability, common EGFR a
Extended one methoxy to a methoxyethoxy chain (erlotinib-like side chain) to improve solubility and mimic known EGFR inh
Introduced morpholine-ethoxy side chain at one methoxy position to boost aqueous solubility and modulate selectivity via
Replaced one methoxy with amino group to probe altered H-bonding/electronics at the 6-position while keeping core scaffo
Swapped one methoxy for fluorine, a smaller bioisostere, to reduce steric bulk and modulate electron density on the quin
Replaced quinazoline CH at position 2 with an amino-substituted pyrimidine-like nitrogen pattern to probe hinge-binding

data.probability_model: platt calibrator fitted on the 43-molecule scaffold-split calibration fold; test-fold ECE 0.1977 -- ABOVE the pre-registered 0.10 threshold, so this probability is a diagnostic, not a headline number
data.caveat: P(>=1 hit) is a model-derived quantity, not a measured hit rate. The two rows bracket the correlation assumption; the truth lies between them. The two oracles disagree on this candidate set (Spearman rho=-0.381 between the activity model and docking), so neither ordering is confirmed by the other.
